title: Change-Order Timing Rates
content:
# Change-Order Timing Rates

Window Replacement Contracts. The change-order fee for the most recent customer change order is multiplied by a change timing share:

1. a change order written before the final measure, or on a contract not yet measured, takes the pre-measure change share of 0.5;
2. a change order written more than 10 days (the late-change day count) after the final measure date, counted in calendar days, takes the late-change share of 1.5;
3. any other change order takes a share of one.

The change order's date is the latest date carrying customer change-order lines (oversize surcharge lines excluded); the final measure date is the date of the contract's completed final measure. The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

## Dates on both sides (hypothetical final measure on 2032-08-10)

| Change order written | Share |
|---|---|
| 2032-08-09 | 0.5 (before the final measure) |
| 2032-08-10 | 1 (the final measure date itself is not before it) |
| 2032-08-20 | 1 (10 days after) |
| 2032-08-21 | 1.5 (11 days after) |
| Contract with no final measure yet | 0.5 |
